body:
Curated 2 FatBaby observations into EMILY/BACKLOG.md INTAKE QUEUE.

Items:
- Founder real-time: 'ensure ops' — after finding shankpit460-server.service (already-enabled systemd unit) was crash-looping 3316+ times because a manually-launched process fought it for the same port all session, fixed by killing the manual process and letting systemd own it. Applied same lesson to WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS: racer_server was never deployed at all (CI-build-only), stood up a new systemd unit for it instead of ad-hoc nohup (2026-08-10T01:08:15Z)
- Founder real-time: WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS Windows client fails with 'FATAL: could not load real terrain from worldapi localhost:7070' — run.bat defaults to localhost, which on the founder's own machine isn't where worldapi actually runs (2026-08-10T01:03:27Z)
